instruction: Create a backup folder inside the Pictures directory and copy all three mountain pictures into it.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a backup subfolder and copying all 3 pictures into it. Evaluator uses image hashes to verify all 3 original images are in the backup folder (verified hashes: picture1=ec076282..., picture2=6ed4239ecc..., picture3=79f45d40d8...).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both instruction requirements: (1) backup folder creation and (2) all three pictures copied
Content-based hash verification is robust - ensures actual image data was copied, not just filenames
Getter extracts state from correct location (/home/user/Pictures/backup) and handles folder non-existence gracefully
Metric comparison logic is correct - uses subset checking to verify all expected hashes are present
Complete coverage - checks for all 3 pictures via their SHA256 hashes
Expected values are semantically correct - three valid SHA256 hashes corresponding to the original images
Data flow is sound: getter extracts hashes → metric compares → expected contains verified hash values
Runtime feasibility confirmed - uses proper env controller methods and includes error handling
